terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms explain how Living Dose works, what you can expect from us and what we expect from you.

sections.title: About these terms
paragraphs: Living Dose is operated by {{legalName}} (RC {{rcNumber}}), {{address}} ("Living Dose", "we" or "us"). These terms apply to our website, apps and services.
By creating an account or using Living Dose, you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use Living Dose.

sections.title: Who can use Living Dose
paragraphs: You must be at least 18 to create an account.
Parents and guardians can add children to their household and manage their profiles. You're responsible for the profiles you manage.

sections.title: Your account
paragraphs: When you create an account, you agree to:
items: keep your sign-in details private;
give accurate information, including health information, so our recommendations are safe for you;
tell us straight away if you think someone else has used your account.
after: You can close your account at any time from your settings or by contacting us.

sections.title: Living Dose is not emergency care
paragraphs: Living Dose supports healthy living and preventive care. It does not replace your own doctor, and it is not for emergencies.
If you or someone else needs urgent help, call {{emergencyNumber}} in Nigeria or your local emergency number, or go to the nearest hospital.

Living Scores, calorie estimates from photos and general content are guides, not diagnoses. Meal plans for health conditions are reviewed by a registered dietitian, but always follow the advice of the professional treating you.

sections.title: Consultations with professionals
paragraphs: Doctors, dietitians, psychologists and coaches on Living Dose are independent professionals. We check their registration before they join and regularly afterwards.
The professional you consult is responsible for the advice they give you. Living Dose provides the platform, scheduling and your records.
You can cancel or reschedule a consultation up to [X] hours before it starts.

sections.title: Food orders and delivery
paragraphs: Living Dose buys products from farmers and suppliers and sells them to you. We describe products and diet labels carefully, but please always check labels if you have an allergy.
Delivery times are estimates. If something arrives damaged, spoiled or wrong, tell us within [X] hours with a photo and we'll replace it or refund you.

sections.title: Paying for things
paragraphs: Creating an account and using the free tools costs nothing. You only pay when you choose to buy food or book a paid service, and you'll always see the full price before you confirm.
Card, bank transfer and USSD payments are processed by licensed payment partners. Where available, you can pay on delivery.
Where the Health Wallet is offered, it is provided with a licensed financial partner under its own terms.

sections.title: Using Living Dose fairly
paragraphs: Please don't:
items: share false or harmful health information, including in community groups;
harass, insult or threaten anyone, including professionals and delivery staff;
try to access other people's accounts or information;
copy, resell or misuse Living Dose or its content.
after: We may suspend or close accounts that break these rules.

sections.title: Content and ownership
paragraphs: Living Dose, our logo, app design and content belong to us or the people who license them to us.
You keep ownership of what you post, such as community posts and meal photos. You allow us to use it to run and improve Living Dose, in line with our privacy policy.

sections.title: Our responsibility to you
paragraphs: We work hard to keep Living Dose accurate, safe and available, but we can't promise it will always be free of errors or interruptions.
Nothing in these terms limits any rights you have under consumer protection law.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these terms as Living Dose grows. If a change is important, we'll tell you in the app or by email before it takes effect.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. [Confirm jurisdiction and dispute process with counsel, including for people using Living Dose from other countries.]

sections.title: Contact us
paragraphs: Questions about these terms? Email {{email}} or write to us at {{address}}.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Your health information belongs to you. This policy explains what we collect, why we collect it and the choices you have.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: {{legalName}} (RC {{rcNumber}}), {{address}}, is responsible for your personal information on Living Dose. You can reach our data protection team at {{privacyEmail}}.

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: We collect only what we need to give you the service:
items: Account details: your name, phone number, email and password.

Profile and health information you choose to share: age, sex, height, weight, health conditions, allergies, diet preferences, meal logs, meal photos and readings such as blood pressure or blood sugar.
Consultation records: appointment details, notes and documents shared between you and your professional.
Orders and delivery: what you order, your delivery address and payment status. We don't store full card numbers.
Device and usage information: how you use the app, so we can keep it secure and working well.

sections.title: Your health information
paragraphs: Health information is sensitive, so we treat it with extra care:
items: We only collect it with your permission, and you can see everything you've shared at any time.
Only you and the professionals you choose to consult can see your health records.
You can withdraw permission at any time. Some features may stop working without it.

sections.title: How we use your information
paragraphs: We use your information to:
items: create your account and household profiles;
calculate your Living Score and build your meal plans;
arrange consultations, orders and deliveries;
send reminders and updates you've asked for;
keep Living Dose safe and prevent fraud;
improve the service, using combined information that doesn't identify you.

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We never sell your personal information. We only share it with:
items: the professionals you choose to consult;
delivery partners, who receive only what they need to deliver your order;
payment partners, to process your payments;
providers who host and secure our systems, under strict contracts;
authorities, only where the law requires it.
after: If you use Diaspora Care, the family member you care for decides what you can see.

sections.title: How we keep it safe
paragraphs: Your information is encrypted when it's stored and when it's sent. Access is limited to people who need it for their work, and every access to health records is logged.
Some of our providers may store data outside Nigeria. When they do, we use the safeguards that data protection law requires.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep your information while your account is open. If you close your account, we delete or anonymise it within [X] days, unless the law requires us to keep certain records for longer, such as medical or tax records.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, and the UK or EU GDPR if you live there, you can:
items: get a copy of your information;
correct anything that's wrong;
ask us to delete your information;
download your information to move it elsewhere;
object to or limit how we use it;
withdraw your consent at any time.
after: Email {{privacyEmail}} to use any of these rights. You can also complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission or the data protection authority where you live.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: Children can't create accounts. Parents and guardians can add children to their household to follow their growth and nutrition, and they control that information.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: We use a small number of cookies and similar tools to keep you signed in, remember your settings such as your country and language, and understand how the site is used. You can control cookies in your browser settings.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we make important changes, we'll tell you in the app or by email before they take effect.
